facts.fact: The World Bank's status report for the Smart Villages project (P167543) says operators awarded rural connectivity contracts had put in US$7,522,666 of private sector investment by 30 June 2024, against a closing target of US$25 million for December 2025; the financiers are unnamed telecom operators and the deal's signing year is not given, so the date is the measurement date.
